listing.name: Naruto: The Broken Bond — Naruto: The Broken Bond — PC Port (Auremana666 v2) (Auremana666)
listing.summary: V2 documented with gameplay/screenshots and bounded performance reports. No complete campaign or Portcove gameplay qualification is established. Laptop/integrated-GPU limits and virtual-controller detection issues remain. Parent higher-frame-rate capability does not automatically become a fork-wide qualification. See below for original-file requirements and setup. Portcove has not confirmed setup or gameplay.

steps.title: Check the required game files
steps.instruction: Use your own Xbox 360 disc ISO or supported extracted files. The parent implementation documents title ID 55530825, media ID 09FFE047, XEX version 0.0.0.3 and SHA256 8f70e79443e36b38e44b6a105dad51fb8909fb615d982753cabaac9b15f0d576. This fork’s current importer must be checked before treating that parent profile as supported. Other revisions are not established.

steps.title: Follow upstream setup
steps.instruction: The project describes a release ZIP: supply your own ISO and start Naruto The Broken Bond PC.exe. Alternatively, build the patched SDK, generate C++ from your own default.xex and compile this fork’s native target. The recorded review did not check release availability or contents.
